learning_outcomes.text: After successful completion of the course, students are able, alone and in a team, to discuss the terms, relationships and models used to describe manufacturing companies.
discuss typical problems of manufacturing companies, especially in light of current and future challenges of ecological, social and economic sustainability.
apply the most important methods for efficient and sustainable management in industrial companies, especially in the sense of the circular economy, to specific problems.
select and justify decision alternatives by applying the learned methods.
critically question the learned methods and independently acquire additional methods.

syllabus_topics: Overall understanding of operational production management with special consideration of sustainability aspects
Application-oriented understanding of fundamental questions and methods in industrial companies
assessment_rules: The assessment is a 90-minute written examination.
